speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you have right knee swelling and a family history of similar issues. To narrow this down, how old are you and exactly how long has this swelling been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular type) with family history of spondyloarthropathy or early-onset arthritis. Given the age, lack of trauma, and family history, this is highly suggestive of an autoimmune etiology rather than infection or mechanical injury. REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, RF, ANA.
